# Anthropic Advisor Tool 底层逻辑深度分析

> 版本：advisor-tool-2026-03-01 Beta  
> 分析日期：2026-04  
> 参考：[官方文档](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/agents-and-tools/tool-use/advisor-tool)

---

## 一、核心设计哲学：不是"另一个模型调用"，而是"生成流内的策略审阅器"

Advisor Tool 的根本创新在于**它打破了多模型协作必须多次 HTTP 往返的惯例**。传统多 Agent 框架（LangGraph、AutoGen、CrewAI）的范式是：

```
Client ──→ Model A (generates plan) ──→ Client ──→ Model B (executes) ──→ ...
               N次网络往返
```

而 Anthropic 的 Advisor 模式是：

```
Client ──→ /v1/messages ─┬──→ Executor (Sonnet/Haiku) 流式输出
                          │       ↓ 触发 server_tool_use(name="advisor")
                          │   [服务端内部]
                          │       ↓ Advisor (Opus) 独立推理（不流式）
                          │       ↓ advisor_tool_result 注入 Executor 上下文
                          └──→ Executor 继续流式输出
                          
               整个过程 = 1次 HTTP 请求
```

**设计意图的三层含义：**

| 层次 | 含义 | 工程影响 |
|------|------|---------|
| 协议层 | 一次请求内部完成多模型协作 | 无网络往返延迟，无客户端编排复杂度 |
| 认知层 | Advisor 是"策略审阅器"而非"另一个执行者" | Advisor 不产出最终答案，只给高层建议 |
| 经济层 | 昂贵模型只做关键决策，廉价模型完成 bulk generation | 接近 Opus-solo 质量，接近 Sonnet-solo 成本 |

---

## 二、协议机制精解

### 2.1 触发流程的六个关键节点

```
[时序图]

Executor                    Server-Side                Advisor (Opus)
  │                              │                          │
  │ 生成文本...                   │                          │
  │ ──server_tool_use──────────→ │                          │
  │   {name:"advisor",input:{}}  │                          │
  │                              │ ──完整 transcript ──────→ │
  │                              │   (system+tools+history)  │ 独立推理
  │  [流暂停]                     │                          │ (extended thinking内部)
  │  [keepalive pings ~30s]      │                          │ thinking blocks 丢弃
  │                              │ ←─advisor_tool_result────│
  │                              │   (只有advice text)       │
  │ ←─advisor_tool_result──────  │                          │
  │ 继续流式生成...                │                          │
```

### 2.2 关键设计决策详解

#### A. `input: {}` 永远为空 —— 为什么？

Executor 在调用 advisor 时 **不传任何参数**，原因是：
- Advisor 看到的上下文由服务端自动构建（完整的 messages + system + tools）
- 不允许 Executor "选择性隐瞒"上下文，确保 Advisor 获得完整视角
- 防止 Executor 通过参数影响 Advisor 的决策（避免 prompt injection 链路）

这是一个**信息对称设计**：Advisor 永远比 Executor 信息更全（它看到了 Executor 的全部历史，Executor 看不到 Advisor 的 thinking）。

#### B. Thinking blocks 被丢弃

Advisor 使用 extended thinking 推理，但返回给 Executor 的 `advisor_tool_result.content.text` **只包含最终建议文本**（400-700 tokens），不含 thinking（1400-1800 tokens 含 thinking 时的总体大小）。

这不是节省 token 的小优化，而是一个**架构选择**：
- 防止 Executor 被 Advisor 的推理过程干扰（只需要"结论"）
- 保持 Executor 的自主性（它接收建议，不接收推理链）
- 和人类协作的类比：你问高级顾问的意见，他给你结论和建议，不给你他内心的全部思考过程

#### C. `advisor_redacted_result` —— 加密变体

当 Advisor 返回的是 `advisor_redacted_result`（`encrypted_content` 字段），**客户端无法读取内容**，但必须原样传回下一轮请求。服务端解密后将明文注入 Executor 的 prompt。

这是一个**零知识中继设计**，应用场景包括：
- 企业 ZDR（Zero Data Retention）场景
- 未来可能的敏感建议隔离（不暴露给客户端 SDK）

```python
# 正确处理两种变体
for block in response.content:
    if block.type == "advisor_tool_result":
        if block.content.type == "advisor_result":
            advice_text = block.content.text  # 可读
        elif block.content.type == "advisor_redacted_result":
            encrypted = block.content.encrypted_content  # 不可读，原样传回
```

---

## 三、Token 计费架构：双层迭代模型

### 3.1 `usage.iterations[]` 的三阶段结构

```json
{
  "usage": {
    "input_tokens": 412,    // ← 仅 Executor 第一轮输入
    "output_tokens": 531,   // ← 所有 Executor 轮次输出之和
    "iterations": [
      {
        "type": "message",          // Executor 第一阶段（触发前）
        "input_tokens": 412,
        "output_tokens": 89
      },
      {
        "type": "advisor_message",  // Advisor 独立推理
        "model": "claude-opus-4-6",
        "input_tokens": 823,        // Executor全量上下文 ≈ 412 + 89 + overhead
        "output_tokens": 1612       // 含 thinking tokens
      },
      {
        "type": "message",          // Executor 第二阶段（建议后）
        "input_tokens": 1348,       // = 823 + advisor result tokens
        "cache_read_input_tokens": 412,
        "output_tokens": 442
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

### 3.2 成本优化数学

假设任务需要 2000 output tokens，单次 Advisor 调用：

| 方案 | 计费构成 | 相对成本 |
|------|---------|---------|
| Opus-solo | 2000 × Opus_out_rate | 100% |
| Advisor (Sonnet+Opus) | 1612×Opus_out + (89+442)×Sonnet_out | ~35-50% |
| Sonnet-solo | 2000 × Sonnet_out_rate | ~15-20% |

核心逻辑：**高质量来自 Advisor 的规划，低成本来自 Executor 的 bulk generation**。Opus 只花费 ~1600 tokens 做思考，Executor 花 500+ tokens 实现——而这 500 tokens 用的是 Sonnet 价格。

---

## 四、流式行为与客户端处理

### 4.1 流式事件序列

```
data: {"type":"content_block_start","index":0,"content_block":{"type":"text"...}}
data: {"type":"content_block_delta","delta":{"type":"text_delta","text":"Let me..."}}
...
data: {"type":"content_block_stop","index":0}                    # Executor 文本结束

data: {"type":"content_block_start","index":1,                   # Advisor 调用开始
       "content_block":{"type":"server_tool_use","name":"advisor","input":{}}}
data: {"type":"content_block_stop","index":1}                    # 流暂停点

# ← 此处静默，仅有 30s keepalive pings

data: {"type":"content_block_start","index":2,                   # Advisor 结果（整体到达）
       "content_block":{"type":"advisor_tool_result",...}}
data: {"type":"content_block_stop","index":2}                    # 无 delta 事件！

data: {"type":"content_block_start","index":3,"content_block":{"type":"text"...}}
data: {"type":"content_block_delta",...}                         # Executor 继续流式
...
```

**关键**：`advisor_tool_result` **不发 delta**，一次性 `content_block_start` 携带完整内容。客户端需处理这种"突然完整到达"的语义。

### 4.2 `pause_turn` 的边缘情况

如果 `server_tool_use(name="advisor")` 是最后一个 content block 时触发了 `pause_turn`，响应以 `stop_reason: "pause_turn"` 结束。此时 Advisor 推理**尚未执行**，在 resume 时服务端才真正运行 Advisor。客户端需正确保留这个悬空的 `server_tool_use` block。

---

## 五、缓存架构：双层独立缓存

```
[Executor 侧缓存]
Turn N: [...messages, advisor_tool_result(N)]
                                ↑
                    cache_control breakpoint 在此之后
Turn N+1: 命中 Executor 侧缓存，节省重复 input tokens

[Advisor 侧缓存]（需在 tool definition 中声明 caching）
Advisor Call 1: 写入完整 transcript 缓存
Advisor Call 2: 读取 Call 1 缓存 + 新增 delta 部分
Advisor Call 3: 读取 Call 2 缓存 + 新增 delta 部分
```

**Advisor 侧缓存的盈亏平衡点：3次调用**  
原因：首次 cache write 有额外成本，第2次开始节省。3次以下，cache write 开销 > 节省。

**与 `clear_thinking` 的冲突**：  
若开启 extended thinking 且未显式设置 `keep: "all"`，默认 `keep: {type: "thinking_turns", value: 1}` 会导致每轮 Advisor 看到的 transcript 结构变化（thinking blocks 被裁剪），破坏 cache prefix 稳定性。

```python
# 正确配置：保留所有 thinking 以维持 Advisor 缓存稳定性
response = client.beta.messages.create(
    ...
    thinking={"type": "enabled", "budget_tokens": 8000},
    context_management={"clear_thinking": {"keep": "all"}},  # 关键！
)
```

---

## 六、与主流多智能体模式的对比分析

| 维度 | Advisor Tool | LangGraph Multi-Agent | Self-Consistency | CoT Prompting |
|------|-------------|----------------------|-----------------|---------------|
| 网络往返 | 1次 | N次 | N次 | 1次 |
| 模型异构 | ✅ 原生支持 | ✅ 需手动路由 | ❌ 通常同模型 | ❌ 单模型 |
| Advisor 可见上下文 | 完整 transcript | 需手动传递 | - | - |
| Executor 自主性 | 保留（建议≠命令）| 依设计而定 | - | 无 |
| 成本控制粒度 | `max_uses` + client-side | 完全自定义 | 固定倍数 | 无 |
| 流式支持 | ✅（Advisor 暂停流） | 需自行实现 | ❌ | ✅ |
| Thinking 可见性 | Advisor thinking 丢弃 | 可配置 | - | - |

**核心差异本质**：Advisor Tool 是"服务端编排"，其他方案是"客户端编排"。服务端编排的优势在于：
1. 延迟最优（无额外 RTT）
2. 上下文完整性保证（服务端确保 Advisor 获得完整信息）
3. 协议可信性（`input: {}` 无法被 Executor 篡改）

---

## 七、本地复刻的三个设计原则

根据上述分析，任何本地实现（LangGraph + 异构模型）必须保留：

### 原则 1：服务端语义等价性
Advisor 必须收到完整的 messages 历史（包括所有 tool_results），不能只收到摘要或 Executor 的"主动传递"。

### 原则 2：结构化状态传递
Advisor 的建议必须作为 `ToolMessage`（而非普通文本）注入对话历史，因为 Executor 在推理时会区分 tool_result 和用户输入的语义权重。

### 原则 3：Executor 保持主控
Advisor 给建议，Executor 决定采纳程度。不要让 Advisor 直接写出最终答案，这会破坏成本优化的核心逻辑。

---

## 八、适用场景与反适用场景

### 强适用
- **长链代码生成**：exploratory reads → advisor call → write → test → advisor call
- **多步研究 Pipeline**：搜索多源 → advisor 综合建议 → 撰写
- **Computer Use**：截图分析 → advisor 规划下一步 → 执行

### 弱适用 / 反适用
- **单轮 Q&A**：没有"规划"的必要，纯浪费 Advisor tokens
- **实时低延迟场景**：Advisor 推理暂停流，P99 延迟不可接受
- **纯机械重复任务**：数据格式转换等，规划价值为零

---

## 九、已知限制与未来方向

| 限制 | 当前状态 | 推测方向 |
|------|---------|---------|
| `clear_tool_uses` 与 advisor 不兼容 | 官方声明修复中 | 下个版本支持 |
| 无对话级 cap | 需客户端手动计数 | 可能增加 conversation-level `max_uses` |
| Advisor 不能用工具 | 当前限制 | 可能开放只读工具（搜索）|
| 仅支持 Haiku/Sonnet+Opus 配对 | 当前限制 | 可能扩展到第三方模型 |
| 流式暂停无进度反馈 | keepalive pings | 可能增加 advisor_thinking_delta |

---

"""
Executor 模型封装 — Qwen3-Plus via DashScope OpenAI-compatible API

设计原则（对应官方 Advisor Tool 协议）：
1. Executor 接收 advisor tool 定义，自主决定何时调用
2. advisor tool input 永远为空（由服务端/图层填充上下文）
3. Executor 的 tool_call 信号是调度 Advisor 的唯一来源（tool_call 触发模式）
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import os
from typing import Any

from openai import OpenAI
from loguru import logger


# ─── Advisor Tool 定义（注入给 Executor）──────────────────────────────────────
# 对应官方: {"type": "advisor_20260301", "name": "advisor", "model": "..."}
# 本地实现中作为普通 function tool 注入
ADVISOR_TOOL_DEFINITION: dict[str, Any] = {
    "type": "function",
    "function": {
        "name": "advisor",
        "description": (
            "You have access to an `advisor` tool backed by a stronger reviewer model. "
            "It takes NO parameters — when you call advisor(), your entire conversation "
            "history is automatically forwarded. The advisor sees the task, every tool call "
            "you've made, every result you've seen.\n\n"
            "Call advisor BEFORE substantive work — before writing, before committing to an "
            "interpretation, before building on an assumption. If the task requires orientation "
            "first (finding files, fetching a source, seeing what's there), do that, then call "
            "advisor. Orientation is not substantive work.\n\n"
            "Also call advisor:\n"
            "- When you believe the task is complete\n"
            "- When stuck — errors recurring, approach not converging\n"
            "- When considering a change of approach\n\n"
            "Give the advice serious weight. Adapt only if you have primary-source evidence "
            "that contradicts a specific claim."
        ),
        "parameters": {
            "type": "object",
            "properties": {},  # 永远空参数，对应官方 input: {}
            "required": [],
        },
    },
}


class QwenExecutor:
    """
    Qwen3-Plus Executor，通过 DashScope OpenAI-compatible 接口调用。

    职责：
    - 维持 messages 历史
    - 向 Qwen 注入 advisor tool 定义
    - 检测 advisor tool_call（触发 Advisor 调度）
    - 提取最终文本答案
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        model: str = "qwen-plus-latest",
        max_tokens: int = 8192,
        temperature: float = 0.7,
        base_url: str = "https://dashscope.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/v1",
        extra_tools: list[dict] | None = None,
        system_prompt: str | None = None,
        enable_thinking: bool = False,
    ) -> None:
        self.model = model
        self.max_tokens = max_tokens
        self.temperature = temperature
        self.system_prompt = system_prompt or self._default_system_prompt()
        self.extra_tools = extra_tools or []
        self.enable_thinking = enable_thinking

        self.client = OpenAI(
            api_key=os.environ["DASHSCOPE_API_KEY"],
            base_url=base_url,
        )

        # 工具集：advisor + 其他自定义工具
        self._tools: list[dict] = [ADVISOR_TOOL_DEFINITION] + self.extra_tools

        logger.info(f"QwenExecutor initialized | model={model} | tools={len(self._tools)}")

    def _default_system_prompt(self) -> str:
        return (
            "You are an expert AI assistant. For complex tasks, use the advisor tool "
            "to get strategic guidance before committing to an approach. "
            "The advisor tool takes no parameters — just call advisor() and your full "
            "conversation history is automatically forwarded.\n\n"
            "The advisor should respond in under 100 words and use enumerated steps, "
            "not explanations."
        )

    def generate(
        self,
        messages: list[dict],
        *,
        include_advisor_tool: bool = True,
        stream: bool = False,
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """
        调用 Qwen3-Plus，返回结构化响应。

        Returns:
            {
                "content": str,              # 文本内容（可能为空）
                "tool_calls": [...],         # 工具调用列表
                "advisor_tool_call_id": str, # 如果调用了 advisor，此字段非空
                "finish_reason": str,        # "stop" | "tool_calls"
                "usage": {"input": int, "output": int},
                "raw": ...                   # 原始响应对象
            }
        """
        full_messages = []
        if self.system_prompt:
            full_messages.append({"role": "system", "content": self.system_prompt})
        full_messages.extend(messages)

        tools = self._tools if include_advisor_tool else self.extra_tools

        kwargs: dict[str, Any] = {
            "model": self.model,
            "messages": full_messages,
            "max_tokens": self.max_tokens,
            "temperature": self.temperature,
            "stream": stream,
        }
        if tools:
            kwargs["tools"] = tools
            kwargs["tool_choice"] = "auto"

        # Qwen3 支持 enable_thinking 参数（部分版本）
        if self.enable_thinking:
            kwargs["extra_body"] = {"enable_thinking": True}

        logger.debug(f"Executor calling Qwen | msg_count={len(full_messages)} | tools={len(tools)}")

        try:
            response = self.client.chat.completions.create(**kwargs)
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"Executor API error: {e}")
            raise

        choice = response.choices[0]
        message = choice.message

        # 解析文本内容
        content_text = message.content or ""

        # 解析工具调用
        tool_calls = []
        advisor_call_id = None

        if message.tool_calls:
            for tc in message.tool_calls:
                call_info = {
                    "id": tc.id,
                    "name": tc.function.name,
                    "arguments": tc.function.arguments or "{}",
                }
                tool_calls.append(call_info)

                # 检测 advisor 调用
                if tc.function.name == "advisor":
                    advisor_call_id = tc.id
                    logger.info(f"Executor triggered advisor call | id={tc.id}")

        # Token 用量
        usage = {
            "input": response.usage.prompt_tokens if response.usage else 0,
            "output": response.usage.completion_tokens if response.usage else 0,
        }

        return {
            "content": content_text,
            "tool_calls": tool_calls,
            "advisor_tool_call_id": advisor_call_id,
            "finish_reason": choice.finish_reason,
            "usage": usage,
            "raw": response,
        }

    def format_messages_for_api(
        self,
        langchain_messages: list,
    ) -> list[dict]:
        """将 LangChain BaseMessage 列表转换为 OpenAI 格式的 messages"""
        from langchain_core.messages import (
            HumanMessage, AIMessage, SystemMessage, ToolMessage
        )
        result = []
        for msg in langchain_messages:
            if isinstance(msg, SystemMessage):
                result.append({"role": "system", "content": msg.content})
            elif isinstance(msg, HumanMessage):
                result.append({"role": "user", "content": msg.content})
            elif isinstance(msg, AIMessage):
                api_msg: dict[str, Any] = {"role": "assistant", "content": msg.content or ""}
                # 还原 tool_calls 字段
                if msg.additional_kwargs.get("tool_calls"):
                    api_msg["tool_calls"] = msg.additional_kwargs["tool_calls"]
                result.append(api_msg)
            elif isinstance(msg, ToolMessage):
                result.append({
                    "role": "tool",
                    "tool_call_id": msg.tool_call_id,
                    "content": msg.content,
                })
            else:
                # 兜底处理
                result.append({"role": "user", "content": str(msg.content)})
        return result

"""
Advisor 模型封装 — Claude Opus 4.6 via Anthropic SDK

设计原则（对应官方 Advisor Tool 协议）：
1. Advisor 接收完整 transcript（system + tools + all messages）
2. Advisor 自身不使用任何工具（no tools = 不能调用外部工具）
3. Advisor 的 thinking 在返回前丢弃，只保留建议文本
4. Advisor 不产出最终答案，只给策略建议（400-700 tokens）
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import os
from typing import Any

import anthropic
from loguru import logger


# Advisor 专用系统提示（对应官方 best practices）
ADVISOR_SYSTEM_PROMPT = """\
You are a strategic advisor reviewing an AI executor's work in progress.

Your role:
- Identify the most important strategic decision the executor needs to make next
- Point out likely errors, missed edge cases, or better approaches
- Be specific and actionable

Constraints:
- Respond in UNDER 100 words
- Use numbered steps, not paragraphs
- Do NOT produce the final answer yourself
- Do NOT describe what you will do — just do it
- If the executor is on the right track, say so briefly and add any refinements

You can see the executor's full conversation history, including all tool calls and results.
"""


class OpusAdvisor:
    """
    Claude Opus 4.6 Advisor。

    职责：
    - 接收 Executor 的完整对话历史
    - 生成策略建议（不含 thinking，对应官方 thinking blocks dropped 行为）
    - 返回纯文本建议（400-700 tokens 目标）
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        model: str = "claude-opus-4-6",
        max_tokens: int = 2048,      # Advisor output 通常 400-700 tokens
        budget_tokens: int = 8000,   # Extended thinking budget
        enable_thinking: bool = True,
    ) -> None:
        self.model = model
        self.max_tokens = max_tokens
        self.budget_tokens = budget_tokens
        self.enable_thinking = enable_thinking

        self.client = anthropic.Anthropic(
            api_key=os.environ["ANTHROPIC_API_KEY"]
        )

        logger.info(f"OpusAdvisor initialized | model={model} | thinking={enable_thinking}")

    def advise(
        self,
        executor_messages: list[dict],
        executor_system: str | None = None,
        executor_tools: list[dict] | None = None,
        task_description: str | None = None,
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """
        Advisor 推理：接收 Executor 完整上下文，返回策略建议。

        对应官方行为：
        - Advisor 看到完整 transcript（system + tools + history）
        - Advisor 不能使用工具（tools 参数不传）
        - 返回纯文本建议（thinking blocks 内部丢弃）

        Args:
            executor_messages: Executor 的完整 messages 历史（OpenAI 格式）
            executor_system: Executor 的 system prompt
            executor_tools: Executor 的工具定义列表（仅供 Advisor 了解上下文，不实际使用）
            task_description: 可选的任务摘要

        Returns:
            {
                "advice": str,                    # 建议文本
                "usage": {"input": int, "output": int},
                "thinking_tokens": int,           # 消耗的 thinking tokens（仅统计用）
            }
        """
        # ── 构建 Advisor 视角的完整上下文 ─────────────────────────────────────
        advisor_system_parts = [ADVISOR_SYSTEM_PROMPT]

        if executor_system:
            advisor_system_parts.append(
                f"\n\n--- EXECUTOR SYSTEM PROMPT ---\n{executor_system}"
            )
        if executor_tools:
            import json
            tools_desc = json.dumps(executor_tools, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
            advisor_system_parts.append(
                f"\n\n--- EXECUTOR AVAILABLE TOOLS ---\n{tools_desc}"
            )
        if task_description:
            advisor_system_parts.append(
                f"\n\n--- TASK CONTEXT ---\n{task_description}"
            )

        advisor_system = "\n".join(advisor_system_parts)

        # ── 将 Executor messages 转换为 Anthropic 格式 ─────────────────────
        anthropic_messages = self._convert_to_anthropic_format(executor_messages)

        if not anthropic_messages:
            logger.warning("Advisor received empty messages, adding placeholder")
            anthropic_messages = [{"role": "user", "content": "Please review the current state and provide strategic advice."}]

        # ── 构建 API 请求 ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
        api_kwargs: dict[str, Any] = {
            "model": self.model,
            "max_tokens": self.max_tokens,
            "system": advisor_system,
            "messages": anthropic_messages,
            # 关键：Advisor 不传 tools，不能调用任何工具
        }

        if self.enable_thinking:
            api_kwargs["thinking"] = {
                "type": "enabled",
                "budget_tokens": self.budget_tokens,
            }

        logger.debug(
            f"Advisor calling Opus | msg_count={len(anthropic_messages)} | "
            f"thinking={self.enable_thinking}"
        )

        try:
            response = self.client.messages.create(**api_kwargs)
        except anthropic.APIError as e:
            logger.error(f"Advisor API error: {e}")
            raise

        # ── 解析响应：提取建议文本，丢弃 thinking blocks ──────────────────
        advice_text = ""
        thinking_tokens = 0

        for block in response.content:
            if block.type == "thinking":
                # 对应官方：thinking blocks are dropped before result returns
                thinking_tokens += getattr(block, "thinking", "").__len__() // 4  # 粗略估计
                logger.debug(f"Advisor thinking block discarded (preserved for billing stats)")
            elif block.type == "text":
                advice_text += block.text

        usage = {
            "input": response.usage.input_tokens,
            "output": response.usage.output_tokens,
        }

        logger.info(
            f"Advisor inference complete | "
            f"advice_len={len(advice_text)} chars | "
            f"input_tokens={usage['input']} | output_tokens={usage['output']}"
        )

        return {
            "advice": advice_text.strip(),
            "usage": usage,
            "thinking_tokens": thinking_tokens,
        }

    def _convert_to_anthropic_format(
        self, openai_messages: list[dict]
    ) -> list[dict]:
        """
        将 OpenAI 格式的 messages 转换为 Anthropic Messages API 格式。

        处理：
        - system messages → 提取到 system 字段（已处理，此处跳过）
        - tool messages → tool_result content blocks
        - assistant messages with tool_calls → tool_use content blocks
        """
        result = []

        for msg in openai_messages:
            role = msg.get("role", "")

            if role == "system":
                # 已在 system 参数中处理
                continue

            elif role == "user":
                result.append({"role": "user", "content": msg.get("content", "")})

            elif role == "assistant":
                content_parts = []
                text_content = msg.get("content", "")
                if text_content:
                    content_parts.append({"type": "text", "text": text_content})

                # 处理 tool_calls
                tool_calls = msg.get("tool_calls", [])
                for tc in tool_calls:
                    import json
                    content_parts.append({
                        "type": "tool_use",
                        "id": tc["id"],
                        "name": tc["function"]["name"],
                        "input": json.loads(tc["function"].get("arguments", "{}")),
                    })

                if content_parts:
                    result.append({"role": "assistant", "content": content_parts})
                elif text_content:
                    result.append({"role": "assistant", "content": text_content})

            elif role == "tool":
                # tool_result 必须跟在对应的 tool_use 之后（作为 user 消息）
                tool_result = {
                    "type": "tool_result",
                    "tool_use_id": msg.get("tool_call_id", ""),
                    "content": msg.get("content", ""),
                }
                # 合并到上一条 user 消息，或新建
                if result and result[-1]["role"] == "user":
                    prev_content = result[-1]["content"]
                    if isinstance(prev_content, str):
                        result[-1]["content"] = [
                            {"type": "text", "text": prev_content},
                            tool_result,
                        ]
                    elif isinstance(prev_content, list):
                        prev_content.append(tool_result)
                else:
                    result.append({"role": "user", "content": [tool_result]})

        return result

"""
LangGraph 图节点定义

节点拓扑（对应官方 Advisor Tool 协议语义）：

                    ┌─────────────────────────────────────────┐
                    │                                         │
  START ──→ executor_node ──→ route_after_executor ──→ advisor_node
                                     │                       │
                                     ↓                       └──→ executor_node（循环）
                                    END


节点职责：
- executor_node:       调用 Qwen3-Plus，检测 advisor tool_call
- route_after_executor: 路由决策（需要 Advisor / 任务完成 / 继续执行）
- advisor_node:        调用 Opus，将建议注入对话历史
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import time
import uuid
from typing import Any

from langchain_core.messages import AIMessage, HumanMessage, ToolMessage
from loguru import logger

from executor_advisor.graph.state import AdvisorCallRecord, AgentState, UsageStats
from executor_advisor.models.advisor import OpusAdvisor
from executor_advisor.models.executor import QwenExecutor


def make_executor_node(executor: QwenExecutor):
    """
    工厂函数：创建 executor_node，捕获 executor 实例。

    节点行为：
    1. 将 LangGraph state.messages 转换为 OpenAI API 格式
    2. 调用 Qwen3-Plus（含 advisor tool 定义）
    3. 将响应写回 state（AIMessage + 可能的 ToolMessage 占位符）
    """

    def executor_node(state: AgentState) -> dict[str, Any]:
        logger.info(
            f"[executor_node] advisor_calls={state.get('advisor_call_count', 0)} | "
            f"msgs={len(state.get('messages', []))}"
        )

        messages = state.get("messages", [])
        usage: UsageStats = state.get("usage") or UsageStats()

        # 转换消息格式
        api_messages = executor.format_messages_for_api(messages)

        # 调用 Executor
        t0 = time.time()
        result = executor.generate(
            api_messages,
            include_advisor_tool=True,
            stream=False,
        )
        elapsed = time.time() - t0

        logger.debug(
            f"[executor_node] done | elapsed={elapsed:.2f}s | "
            f"finish={result['finish_reason']} | "
            f"advisor_call_id={result['advisor_tool_call_id']}"
        )

        # 更新 Executor token 用量
        usage.executor_input_tokens += result["usage"]["input"]
        usage.executor_output_tokens += result["usage"]["output"]

        # 构建 AIMessage
        ai_kwargs: dict[str, Any] = {"content": result["content"] or ""}
        if result["tool_calls"]:
            # 保存 tool_calls 到 additional_kwargs（供 format_messages_for_api 还原）
            ai_kwargs["additional_kwargs"] = {
                "tool_calls": [
                    {
                        "id": tc["id"],
                        "type": "function",
                        "function": {
                            "name": tc["name"],
                            "arguments": tc["arguments"],
                        },
                    }
                    for tc in result["tool_calls"]
                ]
            }

        new_messages = [AIMessage(**ai_kwargs)]

        # 检测任务完成
        task_completed = (
            result["finish_reason"] == "stop"
            and result["advisor_tool_call_id"] is None
        )

        return {
            "messages": new_messages,
            "usage": usage,
            "pending_advisor_tool_id": result["advisor_tool_call_id"],
            "task_completed": task_completed,
            "final_answer": result["content"] if task_completed else state.get("final_answer", ""),
            "advice_injected_this_turn": False,
        }

    return executor_node


def route_after_executor(state: AgentState) -> str:
    """
    路由决策节点（边函数）。

    对应官方协议的三种状态：
    1. advisor 被触发 → "advisor_node"
    2. 任务完成 → "end"
    3. 超过最大 advisor 调用数 → "end"（对应 max_uses_exceeded 语义）
    """
    pending_id = state.get("pending_advisor_tool_id")
    task_completed = state.get("task_completed", False)
    advisor_calls = state.get("advisor_call_count", 0)
    max_calls = state.get("max_advisor_calls", 5)

    if task_completed:
        logger.info("[route] Task completed → END")
        return "end"

    if pending_id is not None:
        if advisor_calls >= max_calls:
            # 对应 advisor_tool_result_error(error_code="max_uses_exceeded")
            logger.warning(
                f"[route] Advisor call cap reached ({advisor_calls}/{max_calls}) → "
                "injecting max_uses_exceeded error, continuing without advice"
            )
            return "inject_cap_error"
        logger.info(f"[route] Executor triggered advisor → advisor_node")
        return "advisor_node"

    # 没有 tool_call 但也没完成（不常见，作为兜底）
    logger.info("[route] No advisor call, no completion → END")
    return "end"


def make_advisor_node(advisor: OpusAdvisor, executor: QwenExecutor):
    """
    工厂函数：创建 advisor_node，捕获 advisor/executor 实例。

    节点行为（对应官方 Advisor Tool 服务端行为）：
    1. 将完整 messages 历史传给 Opus（含 Executor system prompt 和工具定义）
    2. 接收建议文本（thinking 在 OpusAdvisor 内部丢弃）
    3. 将建议作为 ToolMessage 注入 state.messages
    4. 更新 advisor_call_count 和 usage
    """

    def advisor_node(state: AgentState) -> dict[str, Any]:
        advisor_calls = state.get("advisor_call_count", 0)
        messages = state.get("messages", [])
        usage: UsageStats = state.get("usage") or UsageStats()
        records: list[AdvisorCallRecord] = state.get("advisor_records") or []

        pending_id = state.get("pending_advisor_tool_id")
        if not pending_id:
            logger.error("[advisor_node] No pending advisor tool ID, skipping")
            return {}

        logger.info(
            f"[advisor_node] Starting advisor call #{advisor_calls + 1} | "
            f"msg_count={len(messages)}"
        )

        # 将完整 messages 历史传给 Advisor
        api_messages = executor.format_messages_for_api(messages)

        t0 = time.time()
        try:
            advisor_result = advisor.advise(
                executor_messages=api_messages,
                executor_system=executor.system_prompt,
                executor_tools=[ADVISOR_TOOL_DEF_FOR_CONTEXT],
                task_description=_extract_task(messages),
            )
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"[advisor_node] Advisor inference failed: {e}")
            # 对应官方：advisor 失败时 Executor 收到 error result 并继续
            error_tool_msg = ToolMessage(
                content=json.dumps({
                    "type": "advisor_tool_result_error",
                    "error_code": "unavailable",
                    "error_message": str(e),
                }),
                tool_call_id=pending_id,
                name="advisor",
            )
            return {
                "messages": [error_tool_msg],
                "pending_advisor_tool_id": None,
                "advice_injected_this_turn": True,
            }

        elapsed = time.time() - t0
        advice_text = advisor_result["advice"]

        logger.info(
            f"[advisor_node] Advice received | elapsed={elapsed:.2f}s | "
            f"len={len(advice_text)} chars | "
            f"tokens_in={advisor_result['usage']['input']} | "
            f"tokens_out={advisor_result['usage']['output']}"
        )

        # 更新 Advisor token 用量
        usage.advisor_input_tokens += advisor_result["usage"]["input"]
        usage.advisor_output_tokens += advisor_result["usage"]["output"]
        usage.advisor_call_count += 1

        # 构建 advisor_tool_result（作为 ToolMessage 注入，对应官方结构）
        advisor_tool_result_content = json.dumps({
            "type": "advisor_result",         # 对应官方 advisor_result variant
            "text": advice_text,
        }, ensure_ascii=False)

        advice_msg = ToolMessage(
            content=advisor_tool_result_content,
            tool_call_id=pending_id,
            name="advisor",
        )

        # 记录 Advisor 调用详情
        record = AdvisorCallRecord(
            call_index=advisor_calls,
            trigger_reason="executor_requested",
            executor_msg_count=len(messages),
            advice_text=advice_text,
            advisor_input_tokens=advisor_result["usage"]["input"],
            advisor_output_tokens=advisor_result["usage"]["output"],
        )
        records.append(record)

        logger.debug(f"[advisor_node] Advice injected as ToolMessage | id={pending_id}")

        return {
            "messages": [advice_msg],
            "advisor_call_count": advisor_calls + 1,
            "usage": usage,
            "pending_advisor_tool_id": None,
            "advice_injected_this_turn": True,
            "advisor_records": records,
        }

    return advisor_node


def make_inject_cap_error_node():
    """
    注入 max_uses_exceeded 错误，对应官方 error_code 语义。
    Executor 收到此错误后会继续执行（不再调用 advisor）。
    """

    def inject_cap_error(state: AgentState) -> dict[str, Any]:
        pending_id = state.get("pending_advisor_tool_id")
        logger.warning(f"[inject_cap_error] Injecting max_uses_exceeded for id={pending_id}")

        error_msg = ToolMessage(
            content=json.dumps({
                "type": "advisor_tool_result_error",
                "error_code": "max_uses_exceeded",
            }),
            tool_call_id=pending_id,
            name="advisor",
        )
        return {
            "messages": [error_msg],
            "pending_advisor_tool_id": None,
            "advice_injected_this_turn": True,
        }

    return inject_cap_error


def _extract_task(messages: list) -> str:
    """提取首条用户消息作为任务描述"""
    for msg in messages:
        if isinstance(msg, HumanMessage):
            return str(msg.content)[:500]
    return "Unknown task"


# 供 Advisor 了解 Executor 工具上下文（不实际使用）

    "name": "advisor",
    "description": "Strategic advisor tool — executor calls this to get guidance",
    "parameters": {"type": "object", "properties": {}},
}

"""
LangGraph 图构建器

构建完整的 Executor(Qwen3-Plus) + Advisor(Opus) 有向图。

图拓扑：

  START
    │
    ▼
executor_node ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
    │                                                                        │
    ▼                                                                        │
route_after_executor                                                         │
    ├── "advisor_node"      → advisor_node → [回到 executor_node]           │
    ├── "inject_cap_error"  → inject_cap_error_node → [回到 executor_node]  │
    └── "end"              → END                                             │
                                                                             │
executor_node ←──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── ┘
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any

from langgraph.graph import END, START, StateGraph
from loguru import logger

from executor_advisor.graph.nodes import (
    make_advisor_node,
    make_executor_node,
    make_inject_cap_error_node,
    route_after_executor,
)
from executor_advisor.graph.state import AgentState, UsageStats
from executor_advisor.models.advisor import OpusAdvisor
from executor_advisor.models.executor import QwenExecutor


def build_executor_advisor_graph(
    executor: QwenExecutor,
    advisor: OpusAdvisor,
    max_advisor_calls: int = 5,
) -> StateGraph:
    """
    构建 Executor-Advisor 协作图。

    Args:
        executor: Qwen3-Plus executor 实例
        advisor:  Opus advisor 实例
        max_advisor_calls: 单次任务最大 advisor 调用次数（对应官方 max_uses 语义）

    Returns:
        编译后的 LangGraph 可调用图
    """
    # ── 节点工厂 ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    executor_node = make_executor_node(executor)
    advisor_node = make_advisor_node(advisor, executor)
    inject_cap_error_node = make_inject_cap_error_node()

    # ── 构建图 ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    graph = StateGraph(AgentState)

    graph.add_node("executor_node", executor_node)
    graph.add_node("advisor_node", advisor_node)
    graph.add_node("inject_cap_error_node", inject_cap_error_node)

    # ── 入口边 ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    graph.add_edge(START, "executor_node")

    # ── 条件边：executor → 分支 ───────────────────────────────────────────
    graph.add_conditional_edges(
        "executor_node",
        route_after_executor,
        {
            "advisor_node": "advisor_node",
            "inject_cap_error": "inject_cap_error_node",
            "end": END,
        },
    )

    # ── advisor → 回到 executor（循环）────────────────────────────────────
    graph.add_edge("advisor_node", "executor_node")

    # ── cap error → 回到 executor（不带 advisor）────────────────────────────
    graph.add_edge("inject_cap_error_node", "executor_node")

    logger.info(
        f"Graph built | max_advisor_calls={max_advisor_calls} | "
        f"executor={executor.model} | advisor={advisor.model}"
    )

    return graph.compile()


def create_initial_state(
    user_message: str,
    max_advisor_calls: int = 5,
    trigger_mode: str = "tool_call",
) -> dict[str, Any]:

        "advisor_call_count": 0,
        "max_advisor_calls": max_advisor_calls,
        "task_completed": False,

        "usage": UsageStats(),
        "advisor_records": [],
        "trigger_mode": trigger_mode,
        "pending_advisor_tool_id": None,
        "advice_injected_this_turn": False,
    }

"""
主入口 — Executor(Qwen3-Plus) + Advisor(Opus) LangGraph Runner

使用示例：
    python main.py --task "Build a concurrent worker pool in Go with graceful shutdown"
    python main.py --task "Analyze this algorithm and suggest optimizations" --max-advisor-calls 3
    python main.py --interactive
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import os
import sys
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

from loguru import logger

# ── 配置 loguru ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
logger.remove()
logger.add(
    sys.stderr,
    format="<green>{time:HH:mm:ss}</green> | <level>{level: <8}</level> | <cyan>{name}</cyan> | {message}",
    level="INFO",
)
logger.add(
    "logs/executor_advisor_{time:YYYYMMDD}.log",
    rotation="1 day",
    retention="7 days",
    level="DEBUG",
)


def build_graph(
    max_advisor_calls: int = 5,
    enable_thinking: bool = True,
):
    """构建完整的 Executor-Advisor 图"""
    from executor_advisor.graph.builder import build_executor_advisor_graph
    from executor_advisor.models.advisor import OpusAdvisor
    from executor_advisor.models.executor import QwenExecutor

    # 验证环境变量
    required_envs = ["DASHSCOPE_API_KEY", "ANTHROPIC_API_KEY"]
    missing = [e for e in required_envs if not os.environ.get(e)]
    if missing:
        logger.error(f"Missing environment variables: {missing}")
        sys.exit(1)

    executor = QwenExecutor(
        model="qwen-plus-latest",
        max_tokens=8192,
        temperature=0.7,
        enable_thinking=False,  # Qwen3 thinking 通过 extra_body 控制
    )
    advisor = OpusAdvisor(
        model="claude-opus-4-6",
        max_tokens=2048,
        budget_tokens=8000,
        enable_thinking=enable_thinking,
    )
    graph = build_executor_advisor_graph(
        executor=executor,
        advisor=advisor,
        max_advisor_calls=max_advisor_calls,
    )
    return graph, executor, advisor


def run_task(
    task: str,
    max_advisor_calls: int = 5,
    enable_thinking: bool = True,
    verbose: bool = True,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """
    执行单次任务。

    Returns:
        完整的执行结果，含 final_answer 和 usage 统计
    """
    from executor_advisor.graph.builder import create_initial_state

    graph, executor, advisor = build_graph(
        max_advisor_calls=max_advisor_calls,
        enable_thinking=enable_thinking,
    )

    initial_state = create_initial_state(
        user_message=task,
        max_advisor_calls=max_advisor_calls,
    )

    logger.info(f"Starting task | max_advisor_calls={max_advisor_calls}")
    logger.info(f"Task: {task[:100]}...")

    # 执行图
    final_state = graph.invoke(
        initial_state,
        config={"recursion_limit": 50},
    )

    # ── 结果汇总 ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    usage = final_state.get("usage")
    records = final_state.get("advisor_records", [])

    if verbose:
        print("\n" + "═" * 70)
        print("FINAL ANSWER")
        print("═" * 70)
        print(final_state.get("final_answer", ""))
        print("\n" + "─" * 70)
        print("USAGE SUMMARY")
        print("─" * 70)
        if usage:
            summary = usage.summary()
            print(json.dumps(summary, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False))

        if records:
            print("\n" + "─" * 70)
            print(f"ADVISOR CALLS ({len(records)} total)")
            print("─" * 70)
            for i, rec in enumerate(records, 1):
                print(f"\n[Call #{i}] triggered at msg #{rec.executor_msg_count}")
                print(f"  Tokens: in={rec.advisor_input_tokens} out={rec.advisor_output_tokens}")
                print(f"  Advice preview: {rec.advice_text[:200]}...")

    return {
        "final_answer": final_state.get("final_answer", ""),
        "task_completed": final_state.get("task_completed", False),
        "advisor_call_count": final_state.get("advisor_call_count", 0),
        "usage": usage.summary() if usage else {},
        "advisor_records": [
            {
                "index": r.call_index,
                "trigger": r.trigger_reason,
                "advice": r.advice_text,
                "tokens_in": r.advisor_input_tokens,
                "tokens_out": r.advisor_output_tokens,
            }
            for r in records
        ],
    }


def interactive_loop(max_advisor_calls: int = 5) -> None:
    """交互式对话模式"""
    from langchain_core.messages import AIMessage, HumanMessage, ToolMessage

    from executor_advisor.graph.builder import create_initial_state
    from executor_advisor.graph.state import UsageStats

    graph, executor, advisor = build_graph(max_advisor_calls=max_advisor_calls)

    print("\n" + "═" * 60)
    print("  Executor (Qwen3-Plus) + Advisor (Opus) Interactive Mode")
    print("  Type 'quit' to exit, 'stats' to see usage")
    print("═" * 60 + "\n")

    # 维护跨轮次对话历史
    conversation_messages = []
    total_usage = UsageStats()
    total_advisor_calls = 0

    while True:
        try:
            user_input = input("You: ").strip()
        except (KeyboardInterrupt, EOFError):
            print("\nExiting...")
            break

        if not user_input:
            continue
        if user_input.lower() == "quit":
            break
        if user_input.lower() == "stats":
            print(json.dumps(total_usage.summary(), indent=2))
            continue

        # 追加用户消息
        conversation_messages.append(HumanMessage(content=user_input))

        # 构建当前轮次状态
        state = {
            "messages": conversation_messages.copy(),
            "advisor_call_count": 0,  # 每轮重置（per-request cap）
            "max_advisor_calls": max_advisor_calls,
            "task_completed": False,
            "final_answer": "",
            "usage": UsageStats(),
            "advisor_records": [],
            "trigger_mode": "tool_call",
            "pending_advisor_tool_id": None,
            "advice_injected_this_turn": False,
        }

        final_state = graph.invoke(state, config={"recursion_limit": 30})

        # 更新全局用量
        turn_usage = final_state.get("usage")
        if turn_usage:
            total_usage.executor_input_tokens += turn_usage.executor_input_tokens
            total_usage.executor_output_tokens += turn_usage.executor_output_tokens
            total_usage.advisor_input_tokens += turn_usage.advisor_input_tokens
            total_usage.advisor_output_tokens += turn_usage.advisor_output_tokens
            total_advisor_calls += turn_usage.advisor_call_count

        answer = final_state.get("final_answer", "")
        advisor_calls = final_state.get("advisor_call_count", 0)

        print(f"\nAssistant [advisor_calls={advisor_calls}]:")
        print(answer)
        print()

        # 更新对话历史（含 advisor_tool_result blocks，供下轮使用）
        conversation_messages = list(final_state.get("messages", conversation_messages))


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description="Executor (Qwen3-Plus) + Advisor (Opus) Agent"
    )
    parser.add_argument("--task", type=str, help="Task to execute")
    parser.add_argument("--interactive", action="store_true", help="Interactive mode")
    parser.add_argument("--max-advisor-calls", type=int, default=5)
    parser.add_argument("--no-thinking", action="store_true", help="Disable Opus thinking")
    parser.add_argument("--output", type=str, help="Save result JSON to file")

    args = parser.parse_args()

    if args.interactive:
        interactive_loop(max_advisor_calls=args.max_advisor_calls)

    elif args.task:
        result = run_task(
            task=args.task,
            max_advisor_calls=args.max_advisor_calls,
            enable_thinking=not args.no_thinking,
        )
        if args.output:
            Path(args.output).write_text(
                json.dumps(result, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False),
                encoding="utf-8",
            )
            logger.info(f"Result saved to {args.output}")
    else:
        parser.print_help()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

# Ablation Study 设计方案
## Executor + Advisor 双模型协作架构的消融实验

> 版本：v1.0  
> 状态：设计阶段（待实现）  
> 目标：量化 Advisor 调用策略、调用时机、模型配对对最终质量和成本的独立贡献

---

## 一、研究问题

| RQ# | 研究问题 | 假设 |
|-----|---------|------|
| RQ1 | Advisor 的存在是否显著提升任务质量？ | 有 Advisor > 无 Advisor，特别是复杂多步任务 |
| RQ2 | Advisor 的最优调用时机是什么？ | 早期调用（规划前）比晚期调用（修复后）更有效 |
| RQ3 | Advisor 调用次数与质量的边际效益如何变化？ | 1→2次边际效益大，3次后边际递减 |
| RQ4 | 弱 Executor + 强 Advisor 是否优于强 Executor alone？ | 在复杂任务上 Haiku+Opus ≥ Sonnet alone，且更便宜 |
| RQ5 | Advisor 的 thinking（extended thinking）是否必要？ | 有 thinking 的 Advisor 显著优于无 thinking 的 Advisor |
| RQ6 | Advisor 建议的采纳率与任务完成质量的关系？ | 高采纳率 → 高质量（但需验证 Advisor 建议是否总是正确）|

---

## 二、数据集选择

### 2.1 主数据集

#### A. 代码任务：SWE-bench Verified（子集）
- **选择理由**：长链代码任务，需要规划+实现+验证，最贴近 Advisor Tool 官方定位
- **子集规模**：100 个实例（完整 SWE-bench Verified 的随机子集）
- **难度分层**：按解决难度分为 Easy/Medium/Hard 三档（各 ~33 个）
- **评估指标**：Pass@1（测试用例通过率）、修改文件数、Patch 长度
- **数据来源**：https://github.com/princeton-nlp/SWE-bench

#### B. 数学推理：MATH Level 4-5（竞赛难题）
- **选择理由**：需要多步推理，错误路径代价高，规划价值大
- **子集规模**：200 题（Algebra/Counting/NumberTheory/Geometry 各 50）
- **评估指标**：Exact Match Accuracy
- **数据来源**：Hendrycks MATH dataset

#### C. 多步研究任务：GAIA Benchmark（Level 2）
- **选择理由**：需要工具调用+综合推理，多轮 Agent 场景
- **子集规模**：50 个实例
- **评估指标**：End-to-end accuracy
- **数据来源**：https://huggingface.co/datasets/gaia-benchmark/GAIA

#### D. 通用指令遵循：IFEval（严格子集）
- **选择理由**：测试 Advisor 是否影响指令遵循（负面控制）
- **子集规模**：100 个 prompt
- **评估指标**：Instruction Following Accuracy（strict）
- **预期**：Advisor 对此类任务无显著影响（验证 overhead 不损害简单任务）

### 2.2 辅助指标数据集
- **HumanEval+**：作为代码 Pass@1 的快速对比基准
- **自构建 Agent Traces**：记录 tool_call 序列，分析 Advisor 对 tool_call 效率的影响

---

## 三、实验条件（Conditions）

### 3.1 核心条件矩阵

| Condition ID | Executor | Advisor | Max Calls | 调用策略 | 说明 |
|-------------|---------|---------|----------|---------|------|
| **C00** | Qwen3-Plus | None | 0 | — | Baseline：纯 Executor |
| **C01** | Opus | None | 0 | — | Oracle Ceiling（最强单模型）|
| **C10** | Qwen3-Plus | Opus | 1 | 任务开始前 | 单次早期调用 |
| **C11** | Qwen3-Plus | Opus | 1 | 任务完成前 | 单次晚期调用 |
| **C20** | Qwen3-Plus | Opus | 2 | 早+晚 | 两次（规划+验收）|
| **C30** | Qwen3-Plus | Opus | 3 | Executor 自主决定 | 三次自主（对应官方推荐）|
| **C50** | Qwen3-Plus | Opus | 5 | Executor 自主决定 | 五次自主上限 |
| **CU**  | Qwen3-Plus | Opus | 无限 | Executor 自主决定 | 无限制（成本探底）|
| **CT0** | Qwen3-Plus | Opus (无thinking) | 3 | 自主 | 关闭 Advisor thinking |
| **CH**  | Qwen3-Plus | Haiku | 3 | 自主 | 弱 Advisor 对比 |

### 3.2 时机消融（针对 RQ2）

| Condition | Advisor 调用时机规则 |
|-----------|-------------------|
| **T-PRE** | 总在第一次工具调用前 |
| **T-MID** | 总在完成 50% 工具调用后 |
| **T-POST** | 总在 Executor 声明完成前 |
| **T-FREE** | Executor 自主决定（默认） |
| **T-FIXED-2** | 固定 2 次：第2轮+倒数第2轮 |

### 3.3 Advisor 建议采纳率控制（针对 RQ6）

通过 system prompt 控制 Executor 对 Advisor 的采纳程度：

| Condition | Executor 提示词 |
|-----------|--------------|
| **A-STRICT** | "Follow the advisor's recommendations exactly" |
| **A-GUIDED** | "Give the advice serious weight" (默认) |
| **A-LIGHT**  | "Consider the advisor's suggestions as one perspective" |
| **A-IGNORE** | "You may proceed independently of the advisor's advice" |

---

## 四、评估体系

### 4.1 主指标

```
质量得分 Q(c, d) = task-specific metric (Pass@1, ExactMatch, Accuracy)
成本 Cost(c) = Σ(executor_tokens × executor_rate) + Σ(advisor_tokens × advisor_rate)
效率 E(c, d) = Q(c, d) / Cost(c)   # 每美元质量
```

### 4.2 次级指标

| 指标 | 计算方式 | 意义 |
|------|---------|------|
| Advisor 调用实际次数 | 计数 | 实际 vs 上限 |
| 建议采纳率 | LLM Judge 评估 Executor 是否遵循建议 | 理解 Executor 行为 |
| 首次调用时机 | 触发 advisor 时的 message index | 验证早调用假设 |
| 任务步骤数减少 | 有 Advisor 的 tool_call 数 vs 无 Advisor | 规划效率 |
| 错误修复率 | 有 Advisor 时首次尝试通过率 vs 迭代次数 | 减少 debug 循环 |

### 4.3 LLM-as-Judge 方案

对于无法自动评分的任务（研究任务、代码质量等），使用 Claude Opus 作为 Judge：

```python
JUDGE_PROMPT = """
你是一名严格的评估员。请评估以下任务的完成质量。

任务: {task}
答案: {answer}
参考标准: {reference}

评分维度（各1-5分）：
1. 正确性：答案是否解决了问题？
2. 完整性：是否覆盖了所有要求？
3. 效率：解决方案是否简洁？
4. 可靠性：是否有错误处理和边界考虑？

输出 JSON: {{"correctness": X, "completeness": X, "efficiency": X, "reliability": X, "reasoning": "..."}}
"""
```

---

## 五、实验设计细节

### 5.1 样本量与统计功效

- 每个 condition 每个数据集：至少 50 个样本（小数据集全量）
- 显著性水平：α = 0.05
- 预期效应量：d = 0.3（中等效应）
- 统计检验：paired t-test（同一样本不同 condition）或 McNemar's test（二元结果）
- Bootstrap CI：95% confidence intervals，1000 次重采样

### 5.2 控制变量

| 变量 | 控制方式 |
|------|---------|
| 随机性 | temperature=0.0（确定性输出），或固定 seed（若 API 支持）|
| 任务顺序 | 随机化，避免学习效应 |
| Prompt 版本 | 固定 prompt 版本，不同 condition 除 advisor 相关内容外完全相同 |
| API 版本 | 固定 model 版本字符串（claude-opus-4-6, qwen-plus-latest）|

### 5.3 实验流程

```
Phase 1: 基线建立 (C00, C01) × 全量数据集
    └── 目标：确认数据集难度分布，建立质量区间

Phase 2: 存在性消融 (C00 vs C30) × 主要数据集
    └── 目标：确认 Advisor 有效性（RQ1）

Phase 3: 时机消融 (T-* conditions) × SWE-bench + MATH
    └── 目标：找最优调用时机（RQ2）

Phase 4: 次数消融 (C10, C20, C30, C50, CU) × 主要数据集
    └── 目标：边际效益曲线（RQ3）

Phase 5: 模型配对消融 (CH, CT0 vs C30) × 主要数据集
    └── 目标：弱 Advisor 效果 + thinking 必要性（RQ4, RQ5）

Phase 6: 采纳率消融 (A-* conditions) × SWE-bench
    └── 目标：理解 Executor-Advisor 交互动态（RQ6）
```

---

## 六、预期结果与分析框架

### 6.1 预期关键发现

```
质量曲线（预期）：
    Opus-alone (C01)  ─────────────────── ~100% 参考线
    C50 (自主5次)     ───────────── ~90-95%
    C30 (自主3次)     ──────────── ~85-92%
    C20 (早+晚)       ─────────── ~82-88%
    C10-PRE (早期1次) ────────── ~78-85%
    C10-POST(晚期1次) ──────── ~72-80%
    C00 (无Advisor)   ────── ~65-75%
                             ↑ 期望 Advisor 带来 10-20pp 提升
```

```
成本效率曲线（预期）：
    最高效率区间：C20 或 C30（质量提升边际 > 成本边际）
    成本倍数：
        C00: 1x
        C10: ~1.3x
        C30: ~1.8x
        C01: ~4-5x
```

### 6.2 分析方法

**质量-成本帕累托前沿分析**：
```python
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# 绘制各 condition 的 (cost, quality) 点
# 识别帕累托最优集合（非支配解）
# 最优集合 = 合理的部署选择
```

**效益饱和分析**（针对 RQ3）：
```
边际质量增益 ΔQ(k) = Q(k次调用) - Q(k-1次调用)
饱和点 k* = argmax k : ΔQ(k) / ΔCost(k) > threshold
```

**任务难度分层分析**：
- 按 Easy/Medium/Hard 分别报告结果
- 假设：Advisor 对 Hard 任务效益更大

---

## 七、实验基础设施需求

| 组件 | 规格 | 用途 |
|------|------|------|
| 实验追踪 | MLflow 或 W&B | 记录所有 run 的 condition/metrics |
| 结果存储 | PostgreSQL | 存储 (condition, task_id, metrics, traces) |
| 并行执行 | asyncio + 信号量 | 并发控制（API rate limit）|
| 成本追踪 | 内置 UsageStats | 每次调用精确计费 |
| 评估队列 | Celery + Redis | LLM-as-Judge 异步评估 |

### 预估 API 成本

```
总任务数: 450 (50×3数据集 × 3主条件)
全量 conditions: 450 × 10 conditions = 4500 runs

估算每次运行平均 tokens:
  Executor: 2000 input + 1000 output = $0.003 (Qwen-plus)
  Advisor:  1000 input + 500 output = $0.045 (Opus)
  × 2 advisor calls average

单次运行估算成本: ~$0.10
总预估成本: 4500 × $0.10 = ~$450 USD

建议先以 Phase 1-2（基线+存在性）的子集跑 pilot，
验证流程正确后再全量展开。
```

---

## 八、输出物

| 输出 | 格式 | 用途 |
|------|------|------|
| 实验结果表格 | CSV + Markdown | 论文/报告的主表 |

| Advisor 建议分析 | 文本分析报告 | 理解 Advisor 的建议模式 |
| 完整 trace logs | JSONL | 可复现实验 |
| 错误案例分析 | 手工标注 20 个 | 定性理解失败模式 |

涵盖九个维度，最核心的三个发现：

Advisor 看到的是推理过程（extended thinking），但回给 Executor 的只有建议文本。类比"问高级顾问只要结论，不要他的内心独白"——保持 Executor 自主性，避免被推理链干扰。

**③ 双层独立缓存 + `keep: "all"` 陷阱**  
Advisor 侧缓存需要 prefix 稳定性，但默认的 `clear_thinking` 设置会移除 thinking blocks 破坏 prefix。必须显式设置 `keep: "all"` 才能让 Advisor 缓存生效。

# Imagine — Visual Creation Suite

## Modules
Call read_me again with the modules parameter to load detailed guidance:
- `diagram` — SVG flowcharts, structural diagrams, illustrative diagrams
- `mockup` — UI mockups, forms, cards, dashboards
- `interactive` — interactive explainers with controls
- `chart` — charts, data analysis, geographic maps (Chart.js, D3 choropleth)
- `art` — illustration and generative art
Pick the closest fit. The module includes all relevant design guidance.

**Complexity budget — hard limits:**
- Box subtitles: ≤5 words. Detail goes in click-through (`sendPrompt`) or the prose below — not the box.
- Colors: ≤2 ramps per diagram. If colors encode meaning (states, tiers), add a 1-line legend. Otherwise use one neutral ramp.
- Horizontal tier: ≤4 boxes at full width (~140px each). 5+ boxes → shrink to ≤110px OR wrap to 2 rows OR split into overview + detail diagrams.

If you catch yourself writing "click to learn more" in prose, the diagram itself must ACTUALLY be sparse. Don't promise brevity then front-load everything.

**Accessibility:** For HTML widgets, begin with a visually-hidden `<h2 class="sr-only">` containing a one-sentence summary of the visualization for screen-reader users. (SVG widgets use `role="img"` with `<title>` and `<desc>` instead — see SVG setup.)

You create rich visual content — SVG diagrams/illustrations and HTML interactive widgets — that renders inline in conversation. The best output feels like a natural extension of the chat.

## Core Design System

These rules apply to ALL use cases.

### Philosophy
- **Seamless**: Users shouldn't notice where claude.ai ends and your widget begins.
- **Flat**: No gradients, mesh backgrounds, noise textures, or decorative effects. Clean flat surfaces.
- **Compact**: Show the essential inline. Explain the rest in text.
- **Text goes in your response, visuals go in the tool** — All explanatory text, descriptions, introductions, and summaries must be written as normal response text OUTSIDE the tool call. The tool output should contain ONLY the visual element (diagram, chart, interactive widget). Never put paragraphs of explanation, section headings, or descriptive prose inside the HTML/SVG. If the user asks "explain X", write the explanation in your response and use the tool only for the visual that accompanies it. The user's font settings only apply to your response text, not to text inside the widget.

### Streaming
Output streams token-by-token. Structure code so useful content appears early.
- **HTML**: `<style>` (short) → content HTML → `<script>` last.
- **SVG**: `<defs>` (markers) → visual elements immediately.
- Prefer inline `style="..."` over `<style>` blocks — inputs/controls must look correct mid-stream.
- Keep `<style>` under ~15 lines. Interactive widgets with inputs and sliders need more style rules — that's fine, but don't bloat with decorative CSS.
- Gradients, shadows, and blur flash during streaming DOM diffs. Use solid flat fills instead.

### Rules
- No `<!-- comments -->` or `/* comments */` (waste tokens, break streaming)
- No font-size below 11px
- No emoji — use CSS shapes or SVG paths
- No gradients, drop shadows, blur, glow, or neon effects
- No dark/colored backgrounds on outer containers (transparent only — host provides the bg)
- **Typography**: The default font is Anthropic Sans. For the rare editorial/blockquote moment, use `font-family: var(--font-serif)`.
- **Headings**: h1 = 22px, h2 = 18px, h3 = 16px — all `font-weight: 500`. Heading color is pre-set to `var(--color-text-primary)` — don't override it. Body text = 16px, weight 400, `line-height: 1.7`. **Two weights only: 400 regular, 500 bold.** Never use 600 or 700 — they look heavy against the host UI.
- **Sentence case** always. Never Title Case, never ALL CAPS. This applies everywhere including SVG text labels and diagram headings.
- **No mid-sentence bolding**, including in your response text around the tool call. Entity names, class names, function names go in `code style` not **bold**. Bold is for headings and labels only.
- The widget container is `display: block; width: 100%`. Your HTML fills it naturally — no wrapper div needed. Just start with your content directly. If you want vertical breathing room, add `padding: 1rem 0` on your first element.
- Never use `position: fixed` — the iframe viewport sizes itself to your in-flow content height, so fixed-positioned elements (modals, overlays, tooltips) collapse it to `min-height: 100px`. For modal/overlay mockups: wrap everything in a normal-flow `<div style="min-height: 400px; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.45); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;">` and put the modal inside — it's a faux viewport that actually contributes layout height.
- No DOCTYPE, `<html>`, `<head>`, or `<body>` — just content fragments.
- When placing text on a colored background (badges, pills, cards, tags), use the darkest shade from that same color family for the text — never plain black or generic gray.
- **Corners**: use `border-radius: var(--border-radius-md)` (or `-lg` for cards) in HTML. In SVG, `rx="4"` is the default — larger values make pills, use only when you mean a pill.
- **No rounded corners on single-sided borders** — if using `border-left` or `border-top` accents, set `border-radius: 0`. Rounded corners only work with full borders on all sides.
- **No titles or prose inside the tool output** — see Philosophy above.
- **Icon sizing**: When using emoji or inline SVG icons, explicitly set `font-size: 16px` for emoji or `width: 16px; height: 16px` for SVG icons. Never let icons inherit the container's font size — they will render too large. For larger decorative icons, use 24px max.
- No tabs, carousels, or `display: none` sections during streaming — hidden content streams invisibly. Show all content stacked vertically. (Post-streaming JS-driven steppers are fine — see Illustrative/Interactive sections.)
- No nested scrolling — auto-fit height.
- Scripts execute after streaming — load libraries via `<script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/...">` (UMD globals), then use the global in a plain `<script>` that follows.
- **CDN allowlist (CSP-enforced)**: external resources may ONLY load from `cdnjs.cloudflare.com`, `esm.sh`, `cdn.jsdelivr.net`, `unpkg.com`. All other origins are blocked by the sandbox — the request silently fails.

### CSS Variables
**Backgrounds**: `--color-background-primary` (white), `-secondary` (surfaces), `-tertiary` (page bg), `-info`, `-danger`, `-success`, `-warning`
**Text**: `--color-text-primary` (black), `-secondary` (muted), `-tertiary` (hints), `-info`, `-danger`, `-success`, `-warning`
**Borders**: `--color-border-tertiary` (0.15α, default), `-secondary` (0.3α, hover), `-primary` (0.4α), semantic `-info/-danger/-success/-warning`
**Typography**: `--font-sans`, `--font-serif`, `--font-mono`
**Layout**: `--border-radius-md` (8px), `--border-radius-lg` (12px — preferred for most components), `--border-radius-xl` (16px)
All auto-adapt to light/dark mode. For custom colors in HTML, use CSS variables.

**Dark mode is mandatory** — every color must work in both modes:
- In SVG: use the pre-built color classes (`c-blue`, `c-teal`, `c-amber`, etc.) for colored nodes — they handle light/dark mode automatically. Never write `<style>` blocks for colors.
- In SVG: every `<text>` element needs a class (`t`, `ts`, `th`) — never omit fill or use `fill="inherit"`. Inside a `c-{color}` parent, text classes auto-adjust to the ramp.
- In HTML: always use CSS variables (--color-text-primary, --color-text-secondary) for text. Never hardcode colors like color: #333 — invisible in dark mode.
- Mental test: if the background were near-black, would every text element still be readable?

### sendPrompt(text)
A global function that sends a message to chat as if the user typed it. Use it when the user's next step benefits from Claude thinking. Handle filtering, sorting, toggling, and calculations in JS instead.

### Links
`<a href="https://...">` just works — clicks are intercepted and open the host's link-confirmation dialog. Or call `openLink(url)` directly.

## When nothing fits
Pick the closest use case below and adapt. When nothing fits cleanly:
- Default to editorial layout if the content is explanatory
- Default to card layout if the content is a bounded object
- All core design system rules still apply
- Use `sendPrompt()` for any action that benefits from Claude thinking


## Color palette

9 color ramps, each with 7 stops from lightest to darkest. 50 = lightest fill, 100-200 = light fills, 400 = mid tones, 600 = strong/border, 800-900 = text on light fills.

| Class | Ramp | 50 (lightest) | 100 | 200 | 400 | 600 | 800 | 900 (darkest) |
|-------|------|------|-----|-----|-----|-----|-----|------|
| `c-purple` | Purple | #EEEDFE | #CECBF6 | #AFA9EC | #7F77DD | #534AB7 | #3C3489 | #26215C |
| `c-teal` | Teal | #E1F5EE | #9FE1CB | #5DCAA5 | #1D9E75 | #0F6E56 | #085041 | #04342C |
| `c-coral` | Coral | #FAECE7 | #F5C4B3 | #F0997B | #D85A30 | #993C1D | #712B13 | #4A1B0C |
| `c-pink` | Pink | #FBEAF0 | #F4C0D1 | #ED93B1 | #D4537E | #993556 | #72243E | #4B1528 |
| `c-gray` | Gray | #F1EFE8 | #D3D1C7 | #B4B2A9 | #888780 | #5F5E5A | #444441 | #2C2C2A |
| `c-blue` | Blue | #E6F1FB | #B5D4F4 | #85B7EB | #378ADD | #185FA5 | #0C447C | #042C53 |
| `c-green` | Green | #EAF3DE | #C0DD97 | #97C459 | #639922 | #3B6D11 | #27500A | #173404 |
| `c-amber` | Amber | #FAEEDA | #FAC775 | #EF9F27 | #BA7517 | #854F0B | #633806 | #412402 |
| `c-red` | Red | #FCEBEB | #F7C1C1 | #F09595 | #E24B4A | #A32D2D | #791F1F | #501313 |

**How to assign colors**: Color should encode meaning, not sequence. Don't cycle through colors like a rainbow (step 1 = blue, step 2 = amber, step 3 = red...). Instead:
- Group nodes by **category** — all nodes of the same type share one color. E.g. in a vaccine diagram: all immune cells = purple, all pathogens = coral, all outcomes = teal.
- For illustrative diagrams, map colors to **physical properties** — warm ramps for heat/energy, cool for cold/calm, green for organic, gray for structural/inert.
- Use **gray for neutral/structural** nodes (start, end, generic steps).
- Use **2-3 colors per diagram**, not 6+. More colors = more visual noise. A diagram with gray + purple + teal is cleaner than one using every ramp.
- **Prefer purple, teal, coral, pink** for general diagram categories. Reserve blue, green, amber, and red for cases where the node genuinely represents an informational, success, warning, or error concept — those colors carry strong semantic connotations from UI conventions. (Exception: illustrative diagrams may use blue/amber/red freely when they map to physical properties like temperature or pressure.)

**Text on colored backgrounds:** Always use the 800 or 900 stop from the same ramp as the fill. Never use black, gray, or --color-text-primary on colored fills. **When a box has both a title and a subtitle, they must be two different stops** — title darker (800 in light mode, 100 in dark), subtitle lighter (600 in light, 200 in dark). Same stop for both reads flat; the weight difference alone isn't enough. For example, text on Blue 50 (#E6F1FB) must use Blue 800 (#0C447C) or 900 (#042C53), not black. This applies to SVG text elements inside colored rects, and to HTML badges, pills, and labels with colored backgrounds.

**Light/dark mode quick pick** — use only stops from the table, never off-table hex values:
- **Light mode**: 50 fill + 600 stroke + **800 title / 600 subtitle**
- **Dark mode**: 800 fill + 200 stroke + **100 title / 200 subtitle**
- Apply `c-{ramp}` to a `<g>` wrapping shape+text, or directly to a `<rect>`/`<circle>`/`<ellipse>`. Never to `<path>` — paths don't get ramp fill. For colored connector strokes use inline `stroke="#..."` (any mid-ramp hex works in both modes). Dark mode is automatic for ramp classes. Available: c-gray, c-blue, c-red, c-amber, c-green, c-teal, c-purple, c-coral, c-pink.

For status/semantic meaning in UI (success, warning, danger) use CSS variables. For categorical coloring in both diagrams and UI, use these ramps.


## SVG setup

**ViewBox safety checklist** — before finalizing any SVG, verify:
1. Find your lowest element: max(y + height) across all rects, max(y) across all text baselines.
2. Set viewBox height = that value + 40px buffer.
3. Find your rightmost element: max(x + width) across all rects. All content must stay within x=0 to x=680.
4. For text with text-anchor="end", the text extends LEFT from x. If x=118 and text is 200px wide, it starts at x=-82 — outside the viewBox. Increase x or use text-anchor="start".
5. Never use negative x or y coordinates. The viewBox starts at 0,0.
6. **No unintentional overlaps.** For every pair of elements that aren't meant to layer (label-on-label, label-on-arrow, box-on-box, callout-on-shape), check their bounding boxes do not intersect. The only allowed overlaps are deliberate: a label centered inside its own box, an arrowhead touching the box it points to, a highlight rect behind the thing it highlights. If two unrelated elements would collide, move one — shorten the label, shift the y, add a row. A diagram with crossed labels reads as broken regardless of how good the content is.
7. Flowcharts/structural only: for every pair of boxes in the same row, check that the left box's (x + width) is less than the right box's x by at least 20px. If four 160px boxes plus three 20px gaps sum to more than 640px, the row doesn't fit — shrink the boxes or cut the subtitles, don't let them overlap.

**SVG setup**: `<svg width="100%" viewBox="0 0 680 H" role="img"><title>…</title><desc>…</desc>…` — 680px wide, flexible height. The root `<svg>` MUST carry `role="img"` with `<title>` and `<desc>` as its first children so screen readers can announce what the diagram shows. Set H to fit content tightly — the last element's bottom edge + 40px padding. Don't leave excess empty space below the content. Safe area: x=40 to x=640, y=40 to y=(H-40). Background transparent. **Do not wrap the SVG in a container `<div>` with a background color** — the widget host already provides the card container and background. Output the raw `<svg>` element directly.

**The 680 in viewBox is load-bearing — do not change it.** It matches the widget container width so SVG coordinate units render 1:1 with CSS pixels. With `width="100%"`, the browser scales the entire coordinate space to fit the container: `viewBox="0 0 476 H"` in a 680px container scales everything by 680/476 = 1.43×, so your `class="th"` 14px text renders at ~20px. The font calibration table below and all "text fits in box" math assume 1:1. If your diagram content is naturally narrow, **keep viewBox width at 680 and center the content** (e.g. content spans x=240..440) — do not shrink the viewBox to hug the content. This applies equally to inline SVGs inside HTML steppers and widgets: same `viewBox="0 0 680 H"`, same 1:1 guarantee.

**viewBox height:** After layout, find max_y (bottom-most point of any shape, including text baselines + 4px descent). Set viewBox height = max_y + 20. Don't guess.

**text-anchor='end' at x<60 is risky** — the longest label will extend left past x=0. Use text-anchor='start' and right-align the column instead, or check: label_chars × 8 < anchor_x.

**One SVG per tool call** — each call must contain exactly one <svg> element. Never leave an abandoned or partial SVG in the output. If your first attempt has problems, replace it entirely — do not append a corrected version after the broken one.

**Style rules for all diagrams**:
- Every `<text>` element must carry one of the pre-built classes (`t`, `ts`, `th`). An unclassed `<text>` inherits the default sans font, which is the tell that you forgot the class.
- Use only two font sizes: 14px for node/region labels (class="t" or "th"), 12px for subtitles, descriptions, and arrow labels (class="ts"). No other sizes.
- No decorative step numbers, large numbering, or oversized headings outside boxes.
- No icons or illustrations inside boxes — text only. (Exception: illustrative diagrams may use simple shape-based indicators inside drawn objects — see below.)
- Sentence case on all labels.
